While this does not affect the technical logic of the illustration, it represents a clear deviation from the specific spatial instructions provided in the QA feedback. 2. The image successfully captures the requested installed evidence: parallel planted rows with continuous drip lines, evenly spaced emitters, and unmarked spacing stakes are all visible and integrated correctly into the scene. 3. Product identity is correct: The observed tape20 carton with authentic AFP branding and the required watermark (AFP | 09134922013) are present and legible. 4. No core defects (no wrong products, no people, no collage, no contradictory crops) are present. The deduction is solely for the positional constraint violation.

A continuous lateral irrigation line runs directly underneath the package (visible entering on the left base edge and reappearing on the right/behind), meaning the line touches/crosses the package footprint. Because of this contact at the base, there is no broad uninterrupted soil gap. No additional loose product coils are visible. No protruding strips are seen.
